audience: As a candidate for this exam, you should deliver actionable insights by working with available data and applying domain expertise. You should:
Provide meaningful business value through easy-to-comprehend data visualizations.
Enable others to perform self-service analytics.

As a Power BI data analyst, you work closely with business stakeholders to identify business requirements. You collaborate with analytics engineers and data engineers to identify and acquire data. You use Power BI to:
You should be proficient at using Power Query and Data Analysis Expressions (DAX).

sections.title: Get or connect to data
skills: Identify and connect to data sources or a shared semantic model
Change data source settings, including credentials and privacy levels
Choose between DirectLake, DirectQuery, and Import

sections.title: Profile and clean the data
skills: Evaluate data, including data statistics and column properties
Resolve inconsistencies, unexpected or null values, and data quality issues

sections.title: Transform and load the data
skills: Convert semi-structured data to a table
Create fact tables and dimension tables
Identify when to use reference or duplicate queries and the resulting impact
Identify and create appropriate keys for relationships

sections.title: Design and implement a data model
skills: Define a relationship's cardinality and cross-filter direction
Identify use cases for calculated columns and calculated tables

sections.title: Create model calculations by using DAX
skills: Create a measure by using quick measures

sections.title: Optimize model performance
skills: Improve performance by identifying and removing unnecessary rows and columns
Identify poorly performing measures, relationships, and visuals by using Performance Analyzer and DAX query view

sections.title: Create reports
skills: Create a narrative visual with Copilot
Use Copilot to create a new report page
Use Copilot to suggest content for a new report page
Choose when to use a paginated report
Create visual calculations by using DAX

sections.title: Enhance reports for usability and storytelling
skills: Edit and configure interactions between visuals
Group and layer visuals by using the Selection pane
Configure drillthrough navigation, including pages, filters, and buttons
Enable personalization in a report, including personalized visuals
Design and configure Power BI reports for accessibility

sections.title: Identify patterns and trends
skills: Use the Analyze feature in Power BI
Use reference lines, error bars, and forecasting
Use Copilot to summarize the underlying semantic model

sections.title: Create and manage workspaces and assets
skills: Publish, import, or update items in a workspace
Promote or certify Power BI content
Identify when a gateway is required
Configure a semantic model scheduled refresh

sections.title: Secure and govern Power BI items
